_about: Every image on tastefrankfurt.com, from all 57 pages fetched 29 Oct 2026, each downloaded (104 of 104 at 200) and looked at on the contact sheets in contact-sheets/ (the red number on each thumbnail is the id here). 'shows' is what we saw, 'their_alt' is their own alt text. Client logos (051 to 059) are listed but not for use. Zoom every photo you use for third party marks and faces.

films.shows: Their live cooking station at a summer party under a black pavilion, a queue of guests, staff building bowls and handing one over. Guests faces and drink bottle labels visible.
films.use: Their own film. The live cooking moment, full bleed. Recompress, poster frame, never under reduced motion or data saver.

films.shows: A rooftop terrace on an office building at golden hour, guests round their counters, office towers and low sun behind. Nobody recognisable.
films.use: Their own film, the strongest for a full bleed. Summer and company evenings.

logo.shows: A burger drawn in three strokes, a top bun, a wave, a bottom bun, beside Taste Frankfurt over catering. Trace the mark to SVG. Keep the wordmark as their logo, never retype it.
